name: House of Representatives
notes: 318 seats as elected in the May 2025 election (IPU Parline, from the House's own results of 2025-08-05; unofficial, four vacancies then). Party-list representatives are one block (64); the rest by party. This is the election result, not today's affiliations: members switch parties, and the House's current member list (congress.gov.ph/house-members, 317 sitting, read 2026-11-04) names district members without a party. Party-list supporters sit in the Party-list block.

name: Senate of the Philippines
notes: 24 senators by party, full composition after the May 2025 election (IPU Parline, source: the Senate, 2025-07-29). Not today's affiliations. No supporter in the register sits in it.
